title: Cognizance 2026 - Annual Tech Fest
description: The flagship technical symposium of CHARUSAT featuring 15+ coding events, robotics arenas, paper presentations, and tech talks from industry leaders.

title: CHARUSAT National Hackathon 2026
description: 36-hour intense hackathon focusing on AI for Good, Healthcare Innovations, Smart Mobility, and Sustainable Campus Tech with prize pool of ₹1,50,000.

title: Mastering Modern Web Architecture
description: Hands-on masterclass covering ES6+ JavaScript, Fetch API, asynchronous patterns, state management, and modern responsive design without heavy bloat.

title: Spoural 2026 - Sports & Athletics Meet
description: Annual inter-college athletics, cricket, football, basketball, and badminton tournament celebrating sportsman spirit across all institutes.

title: Applied Generative AI & LLM Systems
description: Deep dive into Transformer architectures, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and deploying open-source models responsibly.

title: Cloud Native & Kubernetes Bootcamp
description: Practical crash course on containerization with Docker, orchestrating microservices with Kubernetes, and setting up CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions.

title: Vibrant Gujarat Cultural Fest - Tarang
description: An electrifying evening of traditional folk dance, theatrical drama, musical bands, battle of bands, and fashion parade representing cultural diversity.

title: Cyber Security & Ethical Hacking Summit
description: Explores network penetration testing, web vulnerability hunting (OWASP Top 10), digital forensics, and zero-trust security architectures.

title: Campus Placement Readiness & Mock Interviews
description: Resume reviews, aptitude practice drills, mock technical interviews, and HR negotiation tips conduct by senior alumni working at tier-1 MNCs.

title: Autonomous Robotics Rover Challenge
description: Teams competed in building autonomous line-followers, obstacle-navigating rovers, and terrain crawlers with microcontrollers and LiDAR sensors.

title: Startup Pitch Deck Showcase & Seed Grant
description: Student entrepreneurs pitch early-stage venture ideas to angel investors and industry mentors. Best 3 startups qualify for prototype grant funding.

title: Campus Blood Donation & Health Camp
description: Annual voluntary blood donation drive organized in partnership with Red Cross Society alongside complimentary health and BMI screenings.

title: Data Engineering with Apache Spark & Kafka
description: Practical session on handling high-throughput event streams with Apache Kafka and building scalable analytical pipelines using Apache Spark SQL.

title: IEEE International Distinguished Lecture
description: Distinguished lecture delivered by IEEE Fellow Dr. K. Ramanathan on quantum computing paradigms and post-quantum cryptographic primitives.

title: Clean Green Campus Tree Plantation Drive
description: Join fellow students and faculty to plant 500 native saplings across the green belt, promoting campus biodiversity and environmental consciousness.

title: Full-Stack System Design Seminar
description: Architecting resilient distributed web applications: load balancing, microservices caching with Redis, database sharding, and fault tolerance.
